description: Minimum documents[] shape returned by Signal for an open PLACSP tender (registry GET, list search, and Oracle saved-search run). Metadata/URL only — Signal does not download PDFs for this contract.

item_example.title: Suministro de radar táctico y pliegos de oferta

rules: Deduplicate by uri; order is stable (first-seen, existing before newly merged).
file_name is never empty: if CODICE omits FileName, Signal fills a deterministic fallback from the URI or doc_type.
A later ingest with documents=[] does not erase known documents; new URIs merge without duplicates.
hash is optional when CODICE provides DocumentHash.
Oracle must treat uri as the download target; Signal does not proxy PDF bytes on this path.
